column1: # Lexeme class `colour` (docs/LEXICON_FORMAT_ES.md §9 in the engine repo): colour nouns that also serve
# as adjectives after a noun (una camisa rosa, paredes naranja). Rules: `[class=colour]`, `[class:colour=inv]`.
# Columns: lemma[:sense]  pos  value. Values: inv (the adjective stays singular), both (singular or agreeing plural).
# Members are the noun and, where the lexicon has one, the adjective entry.
# Written from own knowledge of Spanish (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
